'''The Chasm''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the city of [[Gadrin]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
The walls of the cantina were built up to make them appear to be made from limestone, to make it look like a chasm. There were platforms at various heights that contained performers, and patrons could reach these by either climbing the walls or by using [[Turbolift/Legends|repulsor lifts]]. A holographic waterfall was projected next to the bar, although its projector needed maintenance and the waterfall periodically shuddered.

==History==
The cantina was originally a warehouse. A bartender named [[Bolt (bartender)|Bolt]] worked there, along with some [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] security guards and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] comedian [[Deam Schween]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] attacked the cantina. She left a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]] in the cantina's [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]], which was found by one of the patrons, [[Forg F'lopo]]. She then entered the cantina in disguise as the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nek Lawsirk]] and attacked some of the patrons with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. F'lopo filmed the whole thing with the holorecorder and the recording helped to decrease the popularity of the Jedi on Cularin.

The [[Heroes of Cularin]], who were trying to find Lawsirk, traveled to the cantina the next day and asked people about what had happened there.
